def ex(skill, t, n=0, published=True):
    content, solution = SPECS[t]
    e = Exercise.objects.create(
        type=t, title=f"{t}{n}", slug=f"{t.lower()}-{n}",
        content=content, solution=solution, is_published=published,
    )
    e.skills.add(skill)
    return e


def attempt(user, e, number=1, ok=True, hints=0, duration=None):
    a = ExerciseAttempt.objects.create(
        user=user, exercise=e, attempt_number=number, is_correct=ok,
        hints_used=hints, duration_seconds=duration,
    )
    update_skill_mastery(user, e, ok)
    return a


def mastery(user, skill):
    return SkillMastery.objects.get(user=user, skill=skill)

    a = ex(skill, "A")
    attempt(user, a)
    assert not SkillMastery.objects.exists()

    exos = [ex(skill, t, i) for i, t in enumerate("FHE")]

        attempt(user, e, duration=1)  # pas de moyenne : bonus par defaut
    # (60+20+5)/90 -> 94 %
    assert mastery(user, skill).mastery_score == 94

    assert mastery(user, skill).mastery_score == 100

from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError

from apps.learning.models import Module

from .integrity import ensure_publishable, skill_integrity_problems


def _problems_of(exc: ValidationError) -> list[str]:
    return list(exc.messages)


def publish(instance) -> list[str]:
    """Publie `instance`. Retourne la liste des problemes (vide = publie)."""
    if isinstance(instance, Module):
        skills = {s for lesson in instance.lessons.all() for s in lesson.skills_taught.all()}
        problems = skill_integrity_problems(sorted(skills, key=lambda s: s.name))
    else:
        problems = []
        try:
            if hasattr(instance, "skills_taught") or hasattr(instance, "modules"):
                ensure_publishable(instance)
        except ValidationError as exc:
            problems = _problems_of(exc)
    if problems:
        return [f"« {instance} » ne peut pas etre publie : {p}" for p in problems]
    instance.is_published = True
    try:
        instance.save()
    except ValidationError as exc:
        return [f"« {instance} » : {m}" for m in exc.messages]
    return []


def unpublish(instance) -> None:
    instance.is_published = False
    instance.save()
